interface.name: zspaos_content_manager_v1

description.summary: experimental semantics for an owned painted surface

interface.description: A bounded, untrusted semantic tree alongside pixels. Identity comes from the Wayland connection. This interface grants no operations, input provenance, camera or other apps. Anonymous clients may describe only their own mapped surface. This is experimental.

interface.name: zspaos_content_v1

description.summary: replace an owned surface's semantic snapshot

interface.description: One live content object per surface. Submit is a complete replacement, bounded to 61440 UTF-8 bytes, with a strictly increasing sequence and the last accepted revision (initially zero). Acceptance changes scene metadata; it does not prove pixels were presented. The application coalesces unsent snapshots while awaiting a reply. Use wp_presentation for surface presentation and wl_buffer.release for buffer lifetime. No buffer crosses here.
